description: The Municipality of Trento publishes existing cycle paths and shared walking-cycling routes under municipal or provincial responsibility. Its catalogue lists the same route layer in GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML and CSV formats through the municipal GIS export service. Coverage concerns the routes described by the municipality; the metadata does not establish a complete provincial network or a survey date. Access is free under CC0 1.0. These network geometries can supply links for active-mobility routing and network-flow studies. The files were not opened, so connectivity, direction rules, surface quality and positional accuracy remain unverified. The metadata dates describe publication and revision of the catalogue entry, not a verified observation period. Related Trento bicycle-parking and bike-sharing records describe different facilities and services. The source does not establish a ready-made join between those resources and these paths.
